$note: Extracted 6 Aug 2026, read directly from single-page PDFs (pdftotext -layout, poppler). Southern Palms Beach Resort — non-Soroi, Diani Beach. Two source documents used for 2026: the USD 'STO RATES – 2025/2026' card (covers 01.09.25-30.11.26, i.e. the STO/tour-operator tier for essentially all of 2026) and the KES 'TARIFF RATES' RESIDENTS card (covers 04.01.26-30.11.26, Resident tier only). No non-resident KES/published tariff document exists in the 2026 folder covering Jan-Nov 2026 — see gap note below.
residency: STO tier is the general tour-operator (non-resident-facing) trade rate, not explicitly labelled Resident/Non-Resident on its own document. The KES Tariff document IS explicitly labelled '- RESIDENTS' in its filename and is the East-Africa Resident tier.

structuralFindings: STO rate table is priced PER PERSON IN DOUBLE + SINGLE OCCUPANCY, one room category ('Superior room') as the base, with per-night-per-person supplements layered on top for 3 upgraded room types (Superior Deluxe, Ocean Front, Ocean Front Deluxe) rather than each room type getting its own full rate row.
Meal plan is All Inclusive (AI) throughout — no Half/Full Board base tier exists for this property in either document.

GAP: no non-resident KES/published 'Tariff Rate' document exists in the 2026 folder for the Jan-Nov 2026 period — only (a) the USD STO tour-operator rate and (b) the KES Resident tariff. If a non-resident client needs a KES-denominated walk-in rate for Jan-Nov 2026 specifically, it isn't in this folder; the USD STO figure is the only usable non-resident-facing rate for that window.
Children policy differs materially from every Soroi property: 2-12 yrs sharing parents' room = 50% of adult; children in OWN room = 80% of adult (not a fixed dollar/percent-off-sharing scheme).
Extra bed (3rd adult) = 70% of adult rate — a flat percentage, not the Soroi single-supplement style.

seasons.note: Named by explicit From/To date bands in the STO document, not by Peak/Shoulder/Green labels.
